study: Unique study identifier, typically first author and publication year.
multi_arm1: Indicator identifying intervention arms originating from the same multi-arm trial.
multi_arm2: Indicator identifying comparison arms originating from the same multi-arm trial.
outcome_type: Type of outcome analysed (e.g., continuous or dichotomous).
instrument: Outcome measure or instrument used to assess the construct.
rating: Direction of scoring for the outcome measure (higher or lower scores indicating greater symptom severity).
construct: Outcome construct assessed (e.g., eating disorder psychopathology, binge eating frequency, body dissatisfaction).
time_weeks: Time from baseline to assessment, expressed in weeks.
time: Assessment time point (e.g., post-treatment, first follow-up, last follow-up).
mean_arm1: Mean outcome value for the intervention group.
sd_arm1: Standard deviation of the intervention group.
n_arm1: Sample size contributing data for the intervention group.
mean_arm2: Mean outcome value for the comparison group.
sd_arm2: Standard deviation of the comparison group.
n_arm2: Sample size contributing data for the comparison group.
mean_change_arm1: Mean change from baseline for the intervention group.
mean_change_arm2: Mean change from baseline for the comparison group.
sd_change_arm1: Standard deviation of the change scores for the intervention group.
sd_change_arm2: Standard deviation of the change scores for the comparison group.
n_change_arm1: Sample size contributing change score data for the intervention group.
n_change_arm2: Sample size contributing change score data for the comparison group.
dich_paper: Indicator that the study reported dichotomous outcome data.
event_arm1: Number of participants experiencing the event in the intervention group.
event_arm2: Number of participants experiencing the event in the comparison group.
totaln_arm1: Total number of participants included in the dichotomous analysis for the intervention group.
totaln_arm2: Total number of participants included in the dichotomous analysis for the comparison group.
precalc_g: Pre-calculated Hedges' g effect size reported by the study or derived during data extraction.
precalc_g_se: Standard error of the pre-calculated Hedges' g.
precalc_log_rr_se: Standard error of the pre-calculated log risk ratio.
other_stat: Other reported statistics that can be used to derive an effect size when means and standard deviations are unavailable.
baseline_m_arm1: Baseline mean for the intervention group.
baseline_sd_arm1: Baseline standard deviation for the intervention group.
baseline_n_arm1: Baseline sample size for the intervention group.
baseline_m_arm2: Baseline mean for the comparison group.
baseline_sd_arm2: Baseline standard deviation for the comparison group.
baseline_n_arm2: Baseline sample size for the comparison group.
rand_arm1: Number of participants randomized to the intervention group.
rand_arm2: Number of participants randomized to the comparison group.
attr_arm1: Number of participants lost to follow-up in the intervention group.
attr_arm2: Number of participants lost to follow-up in the comparison group.
rand_ratio: Ratio of participants randomized to the intervention and comparison groups.
sg: Risk of bias assessment for sequence generation (random sequence generation).
ac: Risk of bias assessment for allocation concealment.
ba: Risk of bias assessment for blinding of outcome assessment or use of self-report measures.
itt: Risk of bias assessment for intention-to-treat analysis.
rob: Overall risk of bias classification. Low risk indicates that 3 to 4 criteria were met, whereas high risk indicates that 0 to 2 criteria were met.
full_ref: Full bibliographic reference for the study.
format: Digital delivery format of the intervention (e.g., web, CD-ROM, smartphone application, or chatbot).
clinical_interview_diagnosis: Indicator of whether participants had a confirmed eating disorder diagnosis established using a diagnostic interview.
clinical_diagnosis_interview: Eating disorder diagnosis established by diagnostic interview (e.g., anorexia nervosa, bulimia nervosa, binge-eating disorder).
cbt: Indicator of whether the intervention was based primarily on cognitive behavioural therapy.
guided: Indicator of whether the intervention included any form of human guidance or support.
